title: salvia fruticosa subsp. cypria
intro: Salvia fruticosa subsp. cypria, commonly known as Cypriot sage or Cretan sage, is a subspecies of the Salvia fruticosa plant, a member of the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb is native to the eastern Mediterranean region, particularly in Cyprus, and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Salvia fruticosa subsp. cypria include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which can help protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and combat infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, spasmolytic, and anti-anxiety effects.
